title: Industrial Facility: south of the Residential Block behind a 300-coin gate
intent: Add a third district that holds the mech, reachable without buying the alley gate

evidence.description: facility, second gate, containers and tanks
bounds 2880x2720, no pinches, facility unreachable until its gate opens
a Brute from every spawn point, facility included, reaches the player (slowest 76 s)
a Giant from every spawn point reaches the player (slowest 82 s)

constraints.statement: The facility (rows 60-83) is entered only through FACILITY_GATE_RECT at the foot of the avenue south of the spawn; its four spawn points stay idle until that gate is open
It hangs off the Residential Block, not the Alleys, so the mech path costs 500 (gate 300 + mech 200) rather than 560; a run earns 632 coins without a Giant
The map grew to 90 x 85 tiles (2880 x 2720); world and camera bounds, the nav grid, the decal layer and the art all derive from MAP_COLS and MAP_ROWS
Facility solids keep the city rules - touch or stand two tiles apart, every solid at least a tile thick, drawn exactly inside its rectangle
